Drawing set · 28 sheets · Drawn by Mehmet Oya · rev. 2026.11.21

Developer tools that never see your data.

28 utilities for text, encoding, JSON, regex and everyday development. No backend, no logging, no share links — everything runs in your browser.

★ Favorites

    Star a tool in the sidebar to pin it here — then open it from anywhere with g 1–9.

    • 04Line CounterLines, words, characters, bytes and more.

    Privacy by design

    Every page is static HTML served with a strict Content-Security-Policy: only the site's own scripts run, and — except for the HTTP Client — page scripts cannot open network connections (connect-src 'none'), so what you paste is processed locally. Fonts and libraries are self-hosted; no analytics, no third-party requests.

    The Markdown, HTML and Diagram viewers keep your last draft in this browser's localStorage so a reload doesn't lose work; nothing else you type is stored.
